description:
Cast Badgermole Cub by paying its mana cost
When Badgermole Cub enters, its earthbend ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Badgermole Cub trigger, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Badgermole Cub
When Badgermole Cub dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 once.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.
